review: 702.143a-2: 702.143a's own-turn restriction on the foretell special action was not exercised; added a scenario contrasting foretelling on A's turn with trying on B's turn.

scenarios.title: A foretold card can be cast for its foretell cost only after the turn it was foretold
decisions: A takes the foretell special action on Demon Bolt, paying {2} with two Mountains; Demon Bolt is exiled face down.
In the same turn A tries to cast Demon Bolt from exile for its foretell cost {R}, targeting Hill Giant, tapping a third Mountain.

variants.label: same_turn
variants.expected: The cast is not legal: Demon Bolt stays face down in exile, Hill Giant takes no damage, and only the two Mountains paid for foretelling are tapped.

variants.label: own_next_turn
variants.delta: A makes the cast attempt in the first main phase of A's next turn, after the turn in which Demon Bolt was foretold has ended.
variants.expected: The cast is legal for {R}. Demon Bolt deals 4 damage to Hill Giant, which is destroyed and moves to B's graveyard. Demon Bolt moves to A's graveyard.

variants.label: opponents_next_turn
variants.delta: A makes the cast attempt during B's next turn, with one Mountain still untapped from the foretelling turn.
variants.expected: The cast is legal for {R}. Demon Bolt deals 4 damage to Hill Giant, which is destroyed. Demon Bolt moves to A's graveyard.

scenarios.forge_notes: Only A's own untap step untaps the Mountains tapped for foretelling, so the opponents_next_turn variant uses one of the two Mountains that were not tapped for it.

scenarios.title: A card that becomes foretold through an effect is castable for its foretell cost only after that turn ends
decisions: A declares Ethereal Valkyrie as an attacker against B.
Ethereal Valkyrie's attack trigger resolves: A draws Island, then exiles Grizzly Bears from hand face down; it becomes foretold with foretell cost {G}.
B declares no blockers; combat damage is dealt.
In main phase 2 A tries to cast Grizzly Bears from exile for {G}, tapping a Forest.

variants.label: same_turn
variants.expected: The cast is not legal: Grizzly Bears stays face down in exile and the Forest stays untapped. B's life is 16.

variants.label: next_turn
variants.delta: A makes the cast attempt in the first main phase of A's next turn instead of main phase 2 of this turn.
variants.expected: The cast is legal for {G}. Grizzly Bears resolves and enters the battlefield under A's control.

scenarios.title: A card can be foretold only while its owner has priority during their own turn
decisions: With priority in A's first main phase, A takes the foretell special action on Demon Bolt, paying {2} with two Mountains.

variants.label: own_turn
variants.expected: The foretell action is legal: Demon Bolt moves from A's hand to exile face down and both Mountains are tapped.

variants.label: opponents_turn
variants.delta: B is the active player; A tries the foretell action while holding priority in B's first main phase.
variants.expected: The foretell action is not legal: Demon Bolt stays in A's hand and both Mountains stay untapped.

scenarios.forge_notes: Foretelling is a special action, not a cast or activation; the playability record may need a candidate entry for it.
